references.text: Describes the actual making of the golden lampstands and fire pans in pure gold, fulfilling the instruction given here
Mentions the lampstands as part of the equipment associated with the lampstand that the Levites were to carry
Solomon made lampstands and fire pans of pure gold for the temple, according to the pattern of the tabernacle
Repeats that lampstands and fire pans were made of pure gold for the temple
Theological parallel: Solomon's temple restores the tabernacle's standard for holy utensils.
Historical parallel: Solomon's temple preserves the specific detail of the golden lampstands from the tabernacle.
